notes: Page 2 is an introductory storyline page (character opens the box, sorts the pieces). No building steps, so no pieces or joins are added.
Page 3 assembles the Aira mini-doll (hair, head, torso, legs). Those mini-doll parts are not in the parts list or catalogue, so I did not record them as pieces.

The small callout shows a round tile placed on the figure. I read it as the Trans-Purple Tile Round 1x1 (lego-98138). It sits on the figure's hand rather than on a brick, so rests_on is empty and I recorded no join.
The Elven Key Map tile (lego-3068bpr0247) is shown in her other hand but there is no explicit step for it, so I left it out. I will record it when a later page shows it being used.
Step 1: Tan Plate 4x4 (lego-3031) is b2. It is the first piece of this sub-model, so rests_on is empty.
Step 2: Reddish Brown Brick 1x2 (lego-3004) is b3. It sits on the 4x4 plate (b2), at a back corner.
Piece ids continue from b1, the Trans-Purple round tile on page 3.
Step 3: Tan Panel 1x2x1 (lego-4865b) is b4 and the Medium Lavender Tile Round 2x2 (lego-14769, plain) is b5. Both sit on the Tan 4x4 plate (b2). The panel stands in front of the brown brick b3.

Step 4: two Reddish Brown Brick 1x2 (lego-3004), b6 and b7, are added around the panel, forming a U-shaped wall on plate b2. I took both as sitting only on the plate, since they stand beside the panel and b3 rather than on them.

Step 5: White Brick 1x3 (lego-3622) is b8 and White Brick Special 1x1 with Stud on 1 Side (lego-87087) is b9. Together they form a 4-stud white row across the top of the back wall. I assumed the back row of step 4 is b3 and b6, with b7 on the right side. b9 sits at the left end on b3, and b8 spans b3 and b6.

Step 6: the callout shows two Reddish Brown pieces. The first is hard to identify. I read it as the Reddish Brown Brick 2x2 (lego-3003), since all three Reddish Brown 1x2 bricks are already used. The second is the Reddish Brown Brick Special 1x2 with Vertical Clip (lego-30237a). Both are uncertain.

b10 (the 2x2 brick) and b11 (the clip brick) are placed from the front-left. I assumed b10 sits on plate b2 and b11 sits on top of b10. Placement is my best reading of the picture, with no other joins recorded.

Step 7: two Trans-Purple Brick 1x2 without Bottom Tube (lego-3065), b12 and b13, sit side by side on the 4-stud white row. b12 covers the left two studs, so it rests on b9 and b8. b13 covers the right two studs, so it rests on b8.

Step 8: the Magenta Tile 2x4 with Scroll with House Print (lego-87079pr0067) is b14. It lies across the tops of the brown side walls, in front of the trans-purple bricks. I listed b10 and b7 as the pieces under it. Which walls it actually clutches is my best reading of the picture.

Page 8 is step 9, a small sub-assembly. Step 1: Light Bluish Gray Bracket 1x2-2x2 Inverted (lego-99207) is b15. Step 2: two White Plate Special 1x2 jumpers (lego-15573), b16 and b17, go on the bracket's vertical face. Step 3: two Dark Purple Plate Round 1x1 (lego-6141), b18 and b19, go on their studs. Step 4: a Red Plate 1x1 (b21), a White jumper (b20) and the Medium Nougat Cookie Round Tile (b22) are stacked and attached to the bracket. Step 5: the sub-assembly is rotated and then fitted into the model.

I could not tell exactly where the finished sub-assembly mounts. I recorded b15 joined to the Tan Panel b4 (page 5), which is my best reading. All edges use null ports because the exact studs are not clear from the picture.

Correction: the structured output has parts and edges fields, not pieces and other_joins. On pages 4 to 7 (b2 to b14) I put the piece details only in notes and left parts and edges empty, so those pieces are not recorded in the structured fields. This is the first page where parts and edges are filled in. The earlier pages need to be re-run or merged to fill them.
Step 10: Magenta Plate 1x4 (lego-3710) is b23. It lies across the two Trans-Purple 1x2 bricks b12 and b13. The Lavender flower plate (lego-33291) is b24 and goes on one end stud of b23.

Step 11: two small stacks go on b23. Each is a plate (Black b26 or Green b27), then a White jumper (b28 or b29), then a Medium Nougat cookie tile (b30 or b31). The White Feather (lego-64647) is b25. It is attached next to the flower, and I recorded it joined to b24, but where it actually attaches is unclear.

The callout shows two orange cookie tiles, but the parts list has only one lego-98138pr0018. One was already used as b22 on page 8, so the list is one short. I recorded b30 and b31 as the same type anyway. The second may be a different element, for example a plain orange round tile.

Step 12: the Scissors (lego-18920, b32) hang from the clip on the Reddish Brown clip brick b11. The Ruler Tile 1x4 (lego-2431pr0078, b33) attaches to the side stud of the White 1x1 side-stud brick b9 on the left of the model.

Step 13 is a separate small stair sub-model, not attached to the workshop. A White Brick 2x2 (b34) sits on a White Plate 2x3 (b35). Three Dark Purple Tile 1x2 (lego-3069b, b36 to b38) are added: b36 on the exposed studs of the plate, b37 and b38 on the brick.
The scissors and ruler placements follow my earlier guesses for b9 and b11, which were uncertain.
Page 11 starts a second sub-model, shown in the top inset as a tan and purple tower. It is built on a Medium Lavender Plate 4x6 (lego-3032, b39).
Step 1: a Reddish Brown Brick 1x3 (lego-3622, b40) goes on the back right of the plate.

Step 2: a second Reddish Brown Brick 1x3 (b41) and a Reddish Brown Plate 1x4 (lego-3710, b42) are added. I identified the callout pieces by shape. The brick looks short in the picture, so it could be a 1x2 or 1x3. I chose the 1x3 because all three Reddish Brown 1x2 bricks are already used.
I assumed b41 overlaps b40 and also touches the base plate b39, and b42 lies on b39. The picture is ambiguous about which pieces they actually clutch.
Step 3: two White Panel 1x1x1 Corner (lego-6231, b43 and b44) and a Reddish Brown Brick 2x2 (lego-3003, b45) are added on plate b39. I recorded them as resting only on b39.

Step 4: a Magenta Plate 2x4 (lego-3020, b46) is laid over the panels and the 2x2 brick, so I listed b43, b44 and b45 under it. A Reddish Brown Brick 1x3 (lego-3622, b47) is added at the back right, which I recorded as resting on b39 and b40. A White Plate Round 2x2 with Center Stud (lego-18674, b48) goes on top of b46.
The callout brick in step 4 is identified by shape and could be a different length. I chose the 1x3 because it matches the parts still unused. The exact placement of b45 and b47 is my best reading.
Step 5: a Trans-Dark Pink Plate Round 1x1 (lego-6141, b50) goes on the stud of the White round jumper plate b48. The Light Bluish Gray Tap (lego-4599b, b49) goes on top of b50.

Step 6: two Tan Brick 1x1x5 (lego-2453b, b53 and b54) and two Tan Sloped 45° 2x1 with Bottom Pin (lego-3040b, b51 and b52) are added. I put the left column b53 and slope b51 on the lavender base b39, and the right column b54 and slope b52 on the magenta plate b46. This is my best reading of the picture.
The Tan Brick 1x1x5 columns could instead stand on other bricks, such as b45. I did not record pin joins for the slopes, because the picture does not show where the bottom pins go.
Step 7: two Trans-Purple Brick 1x1 (lego-3005, b55 and b56) are placed on the magenta plate b46, one on each side of the tap.

Step 8: two Tan Brick Arch 1x3x3 (lego-13965, b57 and b58) are added so that they meet at the top and form a gothic arch over the tap. b57 is the left arch and b58 is the right arch. I recorded each as joined to its tall tan column (b53 or b54) and to the trans-purple brick on the same side (b55 or b56).
The arch placement is uncertain, because the arch heights and the column heights do not obviously line up in the picture.

Step 9: two Tan Brick Special 1x1 with Headlight (lego-4070, b59 and b60) are added at the top corners of the arch. I recorded b59 as sitting on the left column b53 and left arch b57, and b60 on the right column b54 and right arch b58.
Step 10: two Reddish Brown Plate 2x2 Corner (lego-2420, b61 and b62) go on top of the headlight bricks and the arches, one on each side. b61 rests on b59 and b57, and b62 rests on b60 and b58.
These placements are my best reading, because the arch and column heights are hard to read in the pictures.

Step 11: a White Bracket 1x2-1x2 Inverted (lego-99780, b63) is built with a White jumper plate (lego-15573, b64) pushed onto its vertical face. The bracket then goes on top of the arch centre, between the corner plates. I recorded it as resting on the two arches b57 and b58.

Step 12: a White Tile 1x6 with Groove (lego-6636, b65) is laid across the top front. I recorded it as resting on the corner plates b61 and b62 and the bracket b63. The exact studs under it are uncertain.

Step 13 builds a small side flag. Sub-step 1: a Magenta Plate Special 1x1 with Clip (lego-4081b, b67) goes on one end stud of a White Plate 1x3 (lego-3623, b66). Sub-step 2: a Medium Lavender Sloped 30° 1x2 (lego-85984, b69) goes on the plate. Sub-step 3: a Reddish Brown Carrot Top stem (lego-33183, b68) is pushed through the clip of b67.
The finished flag is attached by the stem b68 to the left side of the arch. I read the target as the hole in the side of the Tan Headlight Brick b59 and recorded it that way. This is uncertain.
The Medium Lavender slope colour is read from the picture, where it looks blue-purple.

Step 14 is the mirrored copy of step 13: a second side flag for the right side. It has a White Plate 1x3 (b70), a Magenta clip plate (b71), a Reddish Brown Carrot Top stem (b72) and a Medium Lavender 30° slope (b73). Its stem goes into the Tan Headlight Brick b60 on the right of the arch.
The parts list has only one lego-85984 Medium Lavender slope, but steps 13 and 14 both use one. The booklet shows two, so the list may be short by one.

Step 15: the Medium Lavender Tile Round 2x2 with Wind Power Icon Print (lego-14769pr1017, b74) goes on the stud of the White jumper plate b64, which sits on the bracket b63 at the top front of the arch.
The right-hand picture only shows the two lavender slope flags (b69 and b73) swinging up and in on their clips. It adds no pieces and no new joins.

Step 16 builds a small shelf. A Reddish Brown Plate 1x4 (lego-3710, b75) carries a Pearl Gold Cheese Slope (lego-54200, b77) at the left end and the Medium Nougat Cookie Round Tile (lego-98138pr0018, b78) at the right end. The short Reddish Brown callout piece is hard to identify. I read it as a Tile 1x2 with Groove (lego-3069b, b76) and recorded it on b75, but it may be a different piece or placed elsewhere.

The parts list has only one cookie tile, and that is the one here (b78). I recorded those three as lego-98138pr0018 earlier. Their types should be lego-98138, colour Pearl Gold.

Possible conflict with page 11: I recorded the thin brown piece b42 there as a Plate 1x4 (lego-3710), and the same part is used for b75 here. The parts list has only one Reddish Brown lego-3710. One of them is probably really a Tile 1x2 or another piece.

Those pieces were never recorded in the structured fields and need a re-run or a merge from the notes.

Pages 8 to 9 and 16 to 18 contain type or colour mistakes. The orange tiles b22, b30 and b31 should be lego-98138 Pearl Gold, not the cookie print. The reddish brown plate b42 on page 11 may be a different element, since the same 1x4 plate is also used as b75 on page 20.

The parts and edges here are additions, except for ten entries that reuse an existing id and replace the earlier type: b16, b17, b64, b22, b30, b31, b42, b69, b73 (nine in all). Everything else already given stays.

Missing pieces added. Pages 3 to 7 (b1 to b14) were earlier only described in notes, so they are now entered as parts and edges. The Elven Key Map tile is new as b94, since it is shown held by the mini-doll on page 3.

Type fixes against the parts list. b16, b17 and b64 are the three Trans-Clear Plate 1x1 (lego-3024), not white jumpers. They look white in the booklet and attach to the bracket faces. b22, b30 and b31 are the three Pearl Gold Tile Round 1x1 (lego-98138), not cookie tiles. b42 is the second Reddish Brown Tile 1x2 with Groove (lego-3069b), not a 1x4 plate. b69 and b73 are the two Dark Purple Brick Curved 3x1 (lego-50950), the flaps on the arch. The jumper plates are then 3 White (b20, b28, b29) and 1 Pearl Gold (b89), and b10 is the fifth Brick 1x3 (lego-3622, Reddish Brown) rather than a 2x2 brick.

Separate groups are real. The booklet builds separate models, shown apart on page 25: the supply stand (b2 to b33), the stair (b34 to b38), the workshop tower with the bird (b39 to b80) and the flying creature (b81 to b93). The mini-doll is not in the parts list. The trans-purple round tile b1 and the map tile b94 are held by her hands, so they are not joined to any model and I left them as separate nodes.
Joins for pages 4 to 7 are my best reading of the pictures, as on the other pages. Ports are left null where the exact stud is unclear.

The remaining mismatches are all from nine entries whose type I got wrong earlier. My last answer re-sent them with the corrected type under the same id, but the check still shows the old types, so same-id re-sends do not replace the earlier entries. I did not add duplicates under new ids, because that would double-count physical pieces.

The nine corrections are b16, b17 and b64 (Trans-Clear lego-3024), b22, b30 and b31 (Pearl Gold lego-98138), b42 (Reddish Brown lego-3069b), and b69 and b73 (Dark Purple lego-50950). With them the piece counts match the parts list exactly. The old entries for these ids (lego-15573, lego-98138pr0018, lego-3710, lego-85984) have to be dropped or overwritten when merging. Additions alone cannot remove them.

The separate groups are real, not a missing connection. The booklet builds four separate models: the supply stand, the stair, the workshop tower with the bird, and the flying creature. The other two groups are b1 and b94, the trans-purple round tile and the map tile. The mini-doll holds them, and the mini-doll is not in the parts list, so they have nothing to be joined to.
If the mini-doll should be a node, tell me and I will add a mini-doll part and join b1 and b94 to it.
